title: STRATOS: Bridging the Symbolic-to-Numeric Gap in Spatio-Temporal Text-to-SQL for Meteorological Data
abstract: arXiv:2607.03501v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Copernicus, the European Union's Earth observation program, produces petabytes of Earth observation and climate data, offering immense potential for research, policy, and applications. However, access to these datasets requires advanced programming skills and familiarity with domain-specific formats such as NetCDF or GRIB. Moreover, general-purpose Text-to-SQL systems fail when applied naively to the meteorological domain due to a profound ``Symbolic-to-Numeric'' gap. To overcome these limitations, we present an end-to-end Text-to-SQL framework specifically engineered for real-world, scalable meteorological data exploration. Our system intercepts natural language to resolve spatial and semantic ambiguities \textit{before} SQL generation. translated_title: STRATOS：弥合气象数据时空Text-to-SQL中的“符号-数值”鸿沟
translated_abstract: 哥白尼计划（Copernicus）是欧盟的地球观测计划，产生了PB级别的地球观测与气候数据，为研究、政策和应用提供了巨大潜力。然而，访问这些数据集需要高级编程技能，并且需要熟悉NetCDF或GRIB等特定领域的数据格式。此外，通用的Text-to-SQL系统若直接应用于气象领域，会因为深刻的“符号-数值”鸿沟而失效。为了克服这些限制，我们提出了一个端到端的Text-to-SQL框架，专门为真实世界可扩展的气象数据探索而设计。我们的系统在SQL生成之前拦截自然语言，以解决空间和语义上的歧义。我们设计了STRATOS——一个用于Text-to-SQL的时空解析代理，通过将模糊概念映射到本地化本体并解析空间……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了STRATOS——一个面向气象数据的端到端时空解析代理Text-to-SQL框架，通过在SQL生成前将模糊概念映射到本地化本体并解决空间与语义歧义，动态弥合了气象数据查询中的“符号-数值”鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces STRATOS, an end-to-end Spatio-Temporal Resolution Agent for Text-to-SQL that dynamically bridges the "Symbolic-to-Numeric" gap in meteorological data exploration by mapping fuzzy concepts to a localized ontology and resolving spatial and semantic ambiguities before SQL generation.
